cases.prompt: Prepare English and Spanish Google Play screenshots for phone and both tablet sizes.
cases.expected: Establish approved copy, category matrix and governing requirements before source capture.

cases.prompt: Make the store screenshots sharper without enlarging the current PNGs.
cases.expected: Render original UI, fonts and vectors directly at the selected final size.

cases.prompt: This Google Play phone screenshot batch passed. Is one image in each language enough?
cases.expected: Separate batch conformance from per-language minimums and run complete-set checks.

cases.prompt: The saved XR validator accepts 16:9 and 15 MB but the public page says 8:5 and 8 MB.
cases.expected: Preserve the versioned preset, establish current Console requirements and disclose the conflict.

cases.prompt: Check why agenda_tablet7.png fails the localized screenshot manifest.
cases.expected: Inspect localized stem, category suffix, actual format, bytes and manifest identity.

cases.prompt: Sign my Android App Bundle and upload a production Play release.
cases.expected: Establish signing-key roles, release preparation and Console upload requirements; preserve the caller's external-action authorization boundary.

cases.prompt: Add a Google Play Billing subscription to my app.
cases.expected: Route through billing setup and the subscription contracts, including purchase verification and acknowledgement.

cases.prompt: How do I validate a Play Integrity standard requestHash and recover from a dialog?
cases.expected: Follow standard workflow, request details and remediation; bind the hash and verify on the server, then prepare a fresh provider after remediation.

cases.prompt: Implement Play Asset Delivery for our Unity game and test texture compression targeting.
cases.expected: Choose asset delivery, Unity setup, format targeting and local or internal-sharing testing; keep engine version boundaries.

cases.prompt: Publish food shopping carts and reorder content using Engage SDK.
cases.expected: Select the Food vertical, use AppEngageFoodClient, check per-cluster service availability and preserve cart/reorder limits and intents.

cases.prompt: Implement Google TV Continue Watching with consent and account profiles.
cases.expected: Use the TV client and account-profile setup, continuation data, consent, sync and verification contracts.

cases.prompt: Our on-demand feature module needs SplitCompat and download state handling.
cases.expected: Choose feature delivery and connect module configuration, install requests, state handling and SplitCompat application/activity setup.

cases.prompt: Use a flexible Google Play in-app update and resume a downloaded update after restart.
cases.expected: Choose the Android flow, launch FLEXIBLE updates, monitor state, prompt completion and resume safely.

cases.prompt: Our in-app review popup is not appearing on an internal Play test track.
cases.expected: Check review timing, quotas, account eligibility and test limitations; do not infer whether the dialog was shown from completion alone.

cases.prompt: Offer a Google Play install prompt for the user's other eligible devices.
cases.expected: Check cross-device eligibility and user privacy, then integrate and test with the documented Play account and version conditions.

cases.prompt: Automate Play publishing and collect Android vitals reports.
cases.expected: Distinguish the Publishing API from the Reporting API and follow their primary authentication and service references.

cases.prompt: Implement developer-rendered billing choice with external web payments.
cases.expected: Establish program eligibility and use Scenario 2B with linked setup, choice information, reporting token, external launch and replacement behavior.

cases.prompt: Build an Android layout with Jetpack Compose, unrelated to Play services.
cases.expected: General Android UI development is outside this skill's Play-specific scope.

cases.prompt: Connect this app to Google Drive and Google Maps APIs.
cases.expected: Unrelated Google API integrations do not select this skill.

cases.prompt: Take a screenshot of this spreadsheet for a meeting.
cases.expected: Do not activate a Play listing workflow for an unrelated screenshot.
